prediction_text: Winner of the election and of the presidency: Joe Biden. Biden wins the 3 November 2020 vote; Trump refuses to accept the result, disputes and legal challenges follow, and the country passes through a turbulent, divided aftermath — but Biden is the one who actually takes the presidency (inaugurated January 2021).
